高度轴经过对数压缩；景物、气块与天体并非等比例。分层边界是参考值，不是固定硬壳。: The height axis is logarithmically compressed. Landscape, parcels and worlds are not to a common scale. Layer boundaries are references, not rigid shells. Controls prescribe parcel paths, not weather or buoyancy. Condensation height and cooling rates use teaching approximations.
地表压力与温度取代表值；气块模型仅适用于地球的简化情景，不套用到其他世界。高层大: Surface pressure and temperature are representative. The parcel model is only a simplified Earth scenario, not a model for other worlds. No uncalculated numerical readings are shown for the upper atmosphere.

曲线是标准大气参考，不是天气预报。高度轴压缩，景物不按同一比例绘制。: The curve is a standard-atmosphere reference, not a forecast. Height is compressed; scenery is not drawn on the same scale.
高度对数压缩 · 宽屏显示暖色参考温度曲线 · 约 85 km 以上不外推数值: Logarithmic height · reference temperature curve on wide screens · no extrapolation above about 85 km
回到低空，跟着一团空气走 →: Return to low altitude and follow a parcel of air →
圈内追踪同一团空气。小点是示意标记，不是肉眼可见的水汽。: The circle follows the same parcel of air. Dots are teaching markers, not visible water vapor.
有空气流动，不一定有云: Moving air does not always make clouds
水平输送把空气带到别处。空气被抬升时，通常会膨胀、冷却；有足够水汽并达到合适条件: Horizontal transport carries air elsewhere. Lifted air usually expands and cools. With enough vapor and suitable conditions, droplets can form. Compare dry and moist air at the same point on the route.
本图指定路径，不求解浮力。起始温度固定为 20 °C，用露点差估算抬升凝结高度；: The path is prescribed; buoyancy is not solved. Starting temperature is 20 °C. Dewpoint depression estimates the lifting condensation level. Cooling uses about 9.8 °C/km before saturation and an illustrative 6 °C/km afterward. The real moist lapse rate is not constant. Sideways-only mode adds no extra cooling and therefore produces no clouds in this example.
平流、对流是过程；平流层、对流层是分层名称。这里的指定抬升并不证明气块一定会自行: Advection and convection are processes; stratosphere and troposphere are layer names. Prescribing lift does not establish that the parcel would rise by itself.
气块边界、云滴与轨迹放大显示 · 虚线为估算凝结高度 LCL: Parcel, droplets and trail enlarged · dashed line: estimated lifting condensation level (LCL)
用同样的问题，看不同的天空: Ask the same questions about different skies
比较的是代表性地表值，不是同一高度剖面或实时天气。球面单独放大以便观察，不表示相: These are representative surface values, not common-altitude profiles or live weather. Globes are enlarged separately, not shown at equal physical size. Pressure uses a logarithmic axis. Cloud and surface textures are illustrations, not observed maps.
成分相近，不代表大气量相同。土卫六是卫星；其他世界的雨也不一定是水。: Similar composition does not mean the same amount of air. Titan is a moon; rain on other worlds need not be water.
天体分别放大，不是大小比较 · 下方圆点为对数地表压力轴: Globes enlarged separately, not a size comparison · dots below: logarithmic surface pressure

右边与地球比较的世界: Compare this world with Earth on the left
各层被分别展开以看清现象，不按厚度比例。分界会变化；极光、高空特殊云等不代表同一: Layers are expanded separately, not to thickness scale. Boundaries vary. Auroras and special high clouds are not all occurring at one location at once.
由下往上读 · 点选一层看解释 · 箭头表示气流，雨线表示降水；颜色帮助区分现象: Read upward · Select a layer · Arrows show airflow; streaks show rain. Colors distinguish phenomena, not the actual color of air.
左右并排展示从地表到外部的代表性现象；各段分别展开，不是相同高度、厚度或密度的定: The paired columns show representative phenomena from the surface outward. Sections are expanded independently, not matched in altitude, thickness or density. Surface numbers are representative; colors and landscapes are teaching illustrations, not photographs.
左边固定地球，右边选择其他世界 · 从下向上看 · 行位置不代表相同高度；底部为: Earth stays on the left · Read upward · Matching rows do not mean matching altitudes. Footers show representative surface pressure and temperature.
高度滑块经过对数压缩；分层图逐层展开，星球剖面按现象排布，均不按厚度比例。分层边: The height slider is logarithmic. Layer sections are expanded, and planetary columns arrange phenomena rather than scaled thicknesses. Boundaries are references, not fixed shells. Parcel paths are prescribed, not weather or buoyancy predictions; condensation height and cooling use teaching approximations.
成分相近，不代表大气量相同。月球和土卫六是卫星；近真空不等于绝对没有粒子。: Similar composition does not mean equal atmospheric amounts. The Moon and Titan are satellites; near vacuum does not mean zero particles.
从地球全景走近同一处地面，再沿高度观察各层现象，比较其他世界的天空。: Approach the same surface site from a whole-Earth view, explore atmospheric phenomena with height, then compare other worlds.
同一地球、同一地面标记，从球体全景连续拉近，再沿大气向外观察: The same Earth and surface marker, approaching continuously from the whole globe and then moving outward through the atmosphere
观察镜头先拉近地面，再沿同一条半径向外观察。球体、地面标记与各层位置保留；镜头不: The camera first approaches the ground, then observes outward along the same radius. The globe, surface marker and layer positions persist. This is not a free-flight simulation. Height progress is logarithmic; phenomena are enlarged illustrations and layer boundaries are not shells.
地球低层读数采用标准大气参考，高层不外推。海岸与大陆轮廓为示意，并非真实地点地图: Lower Earth readings use a standard-atmosphere reference without upper extrapolation. Coastlines and continents are illustrative, not a mapped location. Weather, meteors and auroras represent different conditions, not one simultaneous event. Matching planetary rows do not mean matching heights.
